description: This source file implements the PdfReader class, which provides functionality to identify, open, and read PDF documents, including handling encryption and object references. It also contains helper methods for detecting PDF files and extracting version information.

classes.name: PdfPasswordProviderArgs
classes.description: Encapsulates arguments for the delegate used to retrieve a password for protected PDFs.

methods.name: TestPdfFile
methods.description: Determines if a file or stream is a PDF by inspecting the first bytes and optionally returning the version number.

methods.name: GetPdfFileVersion
methods.description: Internal helper that parses the header bytes to identify the PDF version.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Overloaded methods to open a PDF file or stream with various options such as password, open mode, and password provider function.

methods.name: OpenFromFile
methods.description: Internal method to open a PDF file from a file path, reading the stream and processing the content.

methods.name: OpenFromStream
methods.description: Internal method to open a PDF from a stream, handling trailer parsing, encryption, and object reading.

methods.name: FinalizeReferences
methods.description: Ensures that all object references in the PDF are correctly resolved before finishing reading.

methods.name: ShouldUpdateReference
methods.description: Determines if a PDF reference needs to be updated to point to the actual object or null.

methods.name: RereadUnicodeStrings
methods.description: Re-reads string objects as Unicode based on BOM detection, for proper encoding.
